blocks.text: The country’s leading property developers brought more than 50,000 ready-for-occupancy homes, including condominiums, closer to Filipino workers and their families as the biggest-ever National Housing Expo opened Oct. 19 at the SMX Convention Center in Pasay City. Organized by the Department of Human Settlements and Urban Development (DHSUD) and Pag-IBIG Fund, the two-day Expo brought together more than 80 partner developers offering homes suited to different family needs and budgets, with special prices and buyer incentives complemented by affordable financing through Pag-IBIG Fund. Among the participating developers are SMDC, Amaia Land, Avida Land, DMCI Homes, Filinvest Land, Megaworld Corporation, PH1 World […]...
